name: concept_asma9_pixen
desc: Change only the head, keep everything else: make the snout tip bigger, rounder and bulging forward like a ball, smooth with no nostrils; make both crystal horns much thicker at the base, flat light blue crystal with diagonal facet lines, curving slightly back; make the spiky hair much bigger and fluffier, spiky tufts sticking out past the head outline and bangs hanging over the forehead. Keep the eyes, tongue, colors, body, pose and size the same.
